findingsResolved.issue: Inherited label column layout stacked the search icon above the input
findingsResolved.resolution: Scoped skills toolbar uses row layout and removes global label bottom margin

findingsResolved.issue: Global button flex layout clipped work-summary comparison captions
findingsResolved.resolution: Root scoped comparison buttons to a vertical layout; browser asserts caption below image and inside frame

findingsResolved.issue: Result receipt object changes must use created/modified/deleted keys
findingsResolved.resolution: Root corrected actual receipt field mapping; browser asserts each count and object name

findingsResolved.issue: Metadata reads could remain loading indefinitely
findingsResolved.resolution: 15-second bounded read signals; browser verifies real elapsed timeout and retry recovery

findingsResolved.issue: Successful uninstall response may still contain a cleanup warning
findingsResolved.resolution: UI surfaces warning; real deletion plus explicit warning fixture validates display

findingsResolved.issue: Cancelled task with only a before capture could show it as an after capture; fixed multi-angle label was not evidence-based
findingsResolved.resolution: Filter both phase=before and matching beforeCapture ID, show missing-after explanation, and derive result label from actual phase. Browser covers old malformed fallback and normal single screenshot.

limitations: Runner, scene restore and npx network behavior are explicit protocol fixtures in this browser suite
Work-summary comparison images say UI protocol fixture; these are not generated Blender scenes
Database uses explicitly labeled PostgreSQL WASM over TCP/pg driver, not native PostgreSQL
Deep and light screenshots use current shared VoiceStudio-inspired tokens; no pixel-perfect clone claim
